_comment: Global sensor-ID vocabulary. Index into nn.Embedding in the model.
MUST be identical on the training laptop and on the Pi. Never hard-code these
IDs anywhere else. 0 is reserved for padding.
Bearing IDs 30-47 are SHARED between FEMTO, XJTU-SY and the live MPU-6050 rig,
so the deployed model has actually seen those embedding rows during training.
Live rig maps: ax -> h (radial), ay -> v (radial), az -> a (axial).
The live node sends only rms/kurt/crest, i.e. a SUBSET of the trained channels —
the attention mask handles the missing ones. That is the architecture working.
